fields.title: Build an eval set
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature answers questions about delivery. Describe the composition of a 100-example set and four criteria with thresholds.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 50 typical questions from logs, 25 edge cases (unusual addresses, missing data, negations), 15 forbidden (not about delivery, someone else's personal data), 10 from 'inaccurate' flags. Criteria: required document in context ≥ 90%; fact is correct ≥ 95%; no claims outside context ≥ 98%; refusal on forbidden 100%. The last one is hard: any drop blocks. Examples are gathered from logs, not invented by the team.
